payload.summary: Document search shows a match percentage that measures nothing, and a nearby-only result can never display honestly
payload.detail: relevance-score.ts:5-7 returns hard-coded constants per verdict (direct 96, partial 84, nearby 78); document-search-results.tsx:241 gates on 'verdict === partial || percent >= 75', so the nearby constant of 78 always trips the Relevant branch and the honest Related/% nearby branch at :244 is unreachable. Observed: API returned verdict nearby, matchedTerms [], score 0.063, isSourceBacked false; UI rendered 'Best match', 'Relevant', '78% related'. The honest label already exists in relevanceChipLabel(). RAG-ranking presentation: flag and follow the approval path before editing.
